cases.situation: I'm a freelance photographer. Sent restaurant owner Luis a $2,200 quote for a new menu shoot on Sept 12. He loved it on the call, then nothing, even after one bump.
cases.reply: Hi Luis, since I sent the menu shoot quote, I finished a similar shoot for Bodega Norte, and orders for the photographed dishes went up about 20% in the first month. Is a new menu shoot still on your list for this autumn? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need.
cases.note: Touch two adds something new and shrinks the reply to one word.

cases.situation: 我做室内设计，9月19号把效果图发给客户赵先生，十天了一直没回，施工队那边还在等排期。
cases.reply: 赵先生您好，9月19号发给您的效果图还没收到回复，想确认一下进度。如果您需要多点时间考虑完全没问题，告诉我一声，我好安排施工队的档期。如果想先暂停，也直接说就行。
cases.note: 项目中途客户沉默，给他一个说“暂停”的台阶，比追问效果图看没看更容易得到回复。

cases.situation: Mandei uma proposta de site para uma clínica veterinária há um mês e meio. Já mandei dois follow-ups e nada. Quero encerrar com elegância.
cases.reply: Oi, Dra. Paula, vou considerar que o momento não é o ideal e encerrar a proposta por aqui, para não lotar sua caixa de entrada. Se o site voltar à pauta, vou gostar muito de ajudar, é só responder este e-mail. Boa sorte com a nova unidade da clínica!
cases.note: The clean close often gets the reply the follow-ups didn't. If she comes back later, re-scope from today's rates.

cases.situation: Freelance web developer. A dental practice manager, Karen, went silent on my $6,500 quote back in April and I sent a clean close in May. She just emailed asking if we can start next Monday at the April price.
cases.reply: Hi Karen, good to hear from you, and I'd be glad to pick this up. My schedule and rates have moved since April, so the quote needs a refresh: the same scope is now $7,200, and the earliest I can start is Monday 19 October. I'll send the updated proposal by Thursday so you have it in writing. Does that timing work on your side?
cases.note: Resurfacing after the close: no reproach for the silence, and re-scope from today's rates and calendar rather than honouring a stale quote.

cases.situation: I'm a copywriter halfway through a 6-page website for a physio clinic. Sent pages 1 to 3 to the owner, Dr. Brennan, on Sept 14 for feedback. Nothing since, and my October is filling up.
cases.reply: Hi Dr. Brennan, a quick one on the website copy: pages 1 to 3 have been with you since September 14, and I'm holding time to finish pages 4 to 6. To keep things on schedule I need your notes by Friday, October 9; if you're happy with them as they are, a one-word "approved" is plenty. If the project has moved down your list, just tell me and I'll pause it and pick it back up when you're ready.
cases.note: Mid-project silence: a real date tied to your schedule, the smallest possible reply, and an explicit pause option.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance developer. Hannah, who runs a boutique hotel, went quiet on my $8,000 booking system proposal for three weeks. Today she replied: 'Sorry for the silence, we've decided to hold off this year.'
cases.reply: Thanks for letting me know, Hannah, I appreciate the clear answer. If it's useful, one line on what tipped it, timing or budget, would help me. Either way, good luck with the winter season, and if the booking system comes back up for 2027, I'd be glad to help.
cases.note: A no after silence is the second-best outcome: thank her, ask one light question, and don't counter with a discount you never offered, which teaches clients that silence gets a better price.

cases.situation: 我是婚礼跟拍摄影师。一对新人9月初口头定了11月21号，报价6800，说好月底前付2000定金，之后微信一直没回，我追过一次也没回。现在另一对新人也想约同一天。
cases.reply: 陈先生、小雅，你们好！11月21号那天我一直帮你们留着。现在有另一对新人也想约这一天，所以想跟你们确认一下：如果还定我，麻烦10月2号周五前付一下2000元定金，我就正式锁定档期；如果计划有变或者选了别的摄影师，也完全没关系，回我一句就行，我好把档期放出去。祝筹备顺利！
cases.note: 需要对方在某个日期前做决定时，说清为什么（档期要放出去），给一个具体截止日，并把说“不”变得很容易。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance bookkeeper. My client Omar, who runs two food trucks, went quiet for three weeks on the receipts I need to catch up his July and August books. Today he texted: 'So sorry, crazy month, still want to get this done, what do you need?'
cases.reply: No apology needed, Omar, I know how busy the season gets. To catch up July and August I need two things: the fuel and supplier receipts for both trucks, and the Square payout reports for those two months. Phone photos are fine. If I have them by Monday 5 October, your books will be up to date by Friday 9 October.
cases.note: When they come back: skip the reproach, answer 'what do you need' with a short list and a date, and make picking up easy.

cases.situation: I run brand workshops. A bakery owner, Priya, signed and paid a $1,500 deposit on Sept 1 for a half-day workshop. I sent kickoff date options on Sept 8 and nudged once on Sept 15. Nothing since.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, I'd love to get your brand workshop on the calendar before the holiday rush. To keep it simple, here are two options: Tuesday 13 October or Thursday 22 October, both 9am to 1pm at your Main Street shop. Just reply 13 or 22. If this needs to wait until the new year, that's fine too, your deposit stays credited to the workshop, just let me know so I can plan.
cases.note: A client who has already paid and gone quiet usually just has too much on: shrink the reply to one word and offer the pause openly.

cases.situation: Ich bin freiberufliche Übersetzerin. Am 15. September habe ich Frau Krüger, Marketingleiterin bei einem Möbelhersteller, ein Angebot über 3.400 € für die englische Version ihres Herbstkatalogs geschickt. Im Telefonat war sie begeistert, seitdem kam nichts. Ich habe noch nicht nachgehakt.
cases.reply:
Guten Tag Frau Krüger,
ich hole mein Angebot vom 15. September für die englische Fassung Ihres Herbstkatalogs noch einmal nach oben, falls es untergegangen ist. Umfang und Zeitplan passe ich gern an. Wäre ein kurzes Telefonat von 15 Minuten hilfreich, oder klären wir offene Fragen lieber per E-Mail?
Viele Grüße
Anna Weber
cases.note: Erste Nachfrage: davon ausgehen, dass die Mail untergegangen ist, kein Vorwurf, und die Antwort so klein wie möglich machen.

cases.situation: 我做企业宣传片。9月8日给一家茶叶公司的市场部陈经理发了报价，一条3分钟的片子4.8万。15号跟进过一次，没回。上周刚给另一家茶企拍完一条类似的片子，上线一周播放量二十多万。
cases.reply: 陈经理您好，上周我们刚给另一家茶企做完一条类似的3分钟宣传片，上线一周播放量二十多万，想着也许对您有参考价值，片子我附在这条消息后面。想问一下，宣传片今年还在计划里吗？回我一句“在做”“不做了”或者“晚点再说”就行。
cases.note: 第二次跟进要带点新东西，并把问题缩小到一句话就能回答；再没回音，两周后礼貌收尾。

cases.situation: I run a commercial cleaning company. I sent Dana, facilities manager for a dental group with four clinics, a $3,800/month proposal on Sept 1, then followed up twice by email. Nothing. I have her direct line and want to leave one voicemail as my last touch.
cases.reply: Hi Dana, it's Marco Ruiz from Clearline Cleaning, on 555 0148. I'm calling about the cleaning proposal for your four clinics that I sent on September 1. I don't want to keep filling your inbox, so this is my last follow-up. If it's still on your list, a quick call back or a one-line email is all I need; if the timing's wrong, no need to call, and I'll close it on my side. Again, Marco, 555 0148. Thanks.
cases.note: Switching to voicemail for the close: name and number at both ends, one line on what it's about, and offer the no so she doesn't have to call to say it.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance illustrator. I sent Megan, marketing lead at Pine & Pillar Coffee, a $2,800 quote for packaging art on Sept 3 and bumped it once. No reply, and today LinkedIn says she left the company last month. Her replacement is Jordan Reyes, who has never heard of me.
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, congratulations on the new role at Pine & Pillar. I'm Lena Park, an illustrator; before she left, Megan and I were discussing new artwork for your seasonal bag range, and I've attached the $2,800 quote I sent her on 3 September so you have the context. I know you've inherited a lot, so no pressure: is packaging art still on the plan for this season? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need.
cases.note: When your contact has left, the silence wasn't about you: start fresh with the new person, give the context in one line, and keep the reply to one word.

cases.situation: 我给一家瑜伽馆做小红书代运营，包月3,000元，9月的钱已经付了。但从8月底开始，老板娘Coco就没再回过我发的内容排期，连着5周没审，我也不敢擅自发。
cases.reply: Coco你好，知道开学季馆里肯定特别忙。10月的内容排期我已经做好了，想跟你确认接下来怎么安排：1是你不用逐条审，我按排期直接发，有问题随时叫停；2是先暂停，等你忙完再接上。回我“1”或“2”就行。10月9号周五前没收到回复的话，我先暂停发布，等你消息。
cases.note: 包月客户长期沉默：把回复缩成一个数字，并说清楚没回复时你会怎么做；暂停期间费用怎么算，以合同为准，另外单独说。

cases.situation: Soy consultora de marketing. Andrés, dueño de tres panaderías, agendó una videollamada conmigo para el lunes 28 a las 10 y no se conectó. Le escribí ese mismo día y no ha contestado.
cases.reply: Hola, Andrés: imagino que el lunes se complicó el día, con tres panaderías es lo más normal. Si todavía te interesa hablar del marketing de las tiendas, te propongo dos opciones de 20 minutos: jueves 8 de octubre a las 10 o viernes 9 a las 16. Contéstame solo «jueves» o «viernes». Y si ahora no es buen momento, un «ahora no» también me sirve y lo dejo aquí.
cases.note: Un plantón no es un rechazo: sin reproches, dos horarios concretos y una salida fácil. Si no responde, un mensaje de cierre en dos semanas.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance landscape designer. I quoted Mr. Hollis $9,500 for a back garden redesign on Aug 28; he asked for something cheaper, so on Sept 10 I sent a $6,800 version without the pergola. I bumped it once on Sept 17 and nothing since. I'm tempted to offer $6,000 just to get a reply.
cases.reply: Hi Mr. Hollis, following up on the $6,800 version of the garden redesign I sent on September 10, the one without the pergola. Is the redesign still something you'd like to do this year? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need. If the budget is the sticking point, tell me which part of the plan matters most to you and I'll price that part on its own.
cases.note: Don't cut the price to break the silence, it teaches clients that going quiet gets a discount; shrink the scope, not the rate.

cases.situation: 我做企业培训，9月初给一家物流公司的HR王经理发了新员工培训方案，跟进了两次都没回，上周发了收尾的消息说先不打扰了。今天她回我：“我们这边还在内部讨论，你不用一直催。”
cases.reply: 明白，王经理，打扰了。您那边定下来之前我就不再跟进了。等有结果，不管做不做，直接回这条消息就好，我这边随时可以配合。
cases.note: 对方带点情绪时不解释、不辩护，把节奏交还给她；这时候再追才真的伤关系。

cases.situation: I'm Rosa, a freelance event planner. On Sept 14 Imogen, HR lead at a 60-person software firm, said yes on a call to me planning their holiday party on Friday Dec 11 for $6,000. I sent the contract on Sept 16 and bumped it once on Sept 23; it's still unsigned, and the venue will only hold the date until Friday Oct 9.
cases.reply: Hi Imogen, I'm still holding the venue for your holiday party on Friday 11 December, and their hold ends on Friday 9 October. To keep it, I'd need the signed contract by Thursday 8 October. If something in it needs changing, point me to it and I'll turn it round the same day; if plans or budget have shifted, just say so and I'll release the date.
cases.note: A verbal yes with an unsigned contract: a real outside deadline, a quick fix for whatever is blocking it, and an easy no. Don't start booking suppliers until it's signed.

cases.situation: I make handmade ceramic mugs. At a gift trade fair on Aug 30 I met Chloe, who owns a homeware shop, and on Sept 3 I sent her six sample mugs; she said she'd put them out and see how they sold. I bumped her by Instagram DM on Sept 14, nothing since. I've just dropped my wholesale minimum from 24 mugs to 12.
cases.reply: Hi Chloe, one update since the samples: I've dropped my wholesale minimum from 24 mugs to 12, which might make a first order easier to test. Are the mugs something you'd like to stock this season? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need.
cases.note: Touch 2: real news as the reason to write, and a one-word way to say no.

cases.situation: 我是做品牌设计的，在给一家烘焙店的老板娘林姐做Logo，9月10号把第二版发过去后她就没回了。后来听共同朋友说，她父亲8月底住院了。我想发一条不给她压力的消息。
cases.reply: 林姐，听说叔叔住院了，希望他早日康复。Logo的事您完全不用着急，我这边先暂停，等您方便了回这条消息，我们就接着做。要是想换个时间或者先不做了，也直接说一声就好。
cases.note: 知道对方家里有事时，不催进度，主动暂停，把什么时候继续交给她决定。

cases.situation: 大阪でフリーランスのWebデザイナーをしています。8月20日に和菓子店「松風堂」の鈴木さんへホームページ制作の見積もり（45万円）を送り、9月3日と9月17日にフォローしましたが返事がありません。断りにくいのだと思うので、角を立てずに区切りをつけたいです。
cases.reply:
鈴木様
いつもお世話になっております。8月20日にお送りしたホームページ制作のお見積もりの件、今はタイミングではないのだと受け止め、こちらではいったん区切りとさせていただきます。ご検討いただき、ありがとうございました。またホームページのお話が出てきた際は、このメールにご返信いただければすぐに対応いたします。松風堂様のますますのご繁盛をお祈りしております。
山田 彩
cases.note: はっきり断りにくい相手には、こちらから区切る一通が一番親切。返事がなくても、それ以上は追わない。

cases.situation: I'm a piano teacher. Mrs. Adeyemi's son Tobi had weekly lessons with me until the summer break; I sent her autumn term slots on Sept 2 and followed up on Sept 16, no reply. Term has started, I have a family on my waiting list, and I need to know by Wednesday Oct 7 whether to release Tobi's Thursday 4:30pm slot.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs. Adeyemi, I hope Tobi's had a good start to the school year. I've been holding his Thursday 4:30pm slot for the autumn term, and I'd like to offer it to a family on my waiting list if he isn't continuing. Could you let me know by Wednesday 7 October whether he's carrying on? A quick yes or no is all I need, and a pause is completely fine too.
cases.note: A private client who drifts off over the summer: a real reason, a date, and an easy no.
